heading: It knows which room it's in.

said.line: Play some jazz in the kitchen.

body: Every puck has a room, so music from the kitchen puck means the kitchen speaker. Then turn the puck itself, the whole of it, and the music turns up with it.
house: The kitchen lights up yellow and notes rise from its speaker. When the puck is turned they grow, and so does the music.

faces.name: volume
faces.alt: The puck's volume face: 42, with a yellow arc most of the way round.

still.name: music
still.alt: The kitchen in the card house glows yellow, notes rising from it, and the puck shows two yellow bars.
